card.text: Explore Janus with Cassini imagery, mapped radial height and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Janus shares an orbit with Epimetheus just beyond Saturn’s main rings. Their gravitational interaction exchanges the inner and outer tracks about every four years. Cassini photographed a small, irregular world covered in softened craters.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to an 89.2 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
